scope: Real-tokenizer CPU validation on the existing authorized GPU host; not GPU inference
parent_checks: Returned exact bytes/hash, schema, purpose, offered-tape provenance, 88/88 equality, tokenizer fingerprint, before/after assets and local source SHA matches.
version_provenance_limit: Package metadata read from this host. This attempt did not start or connect to a backend process; installed vLLM is not evidence that a specific backend binary/config was executed.
new_serving_preflight_requirement: Root gateway loads tokenizer using MODEL_NAME and can silently fall back to a character heuristic if the repository ID is not in its cache. Configure the explicit verified local model path, expose the matching backend model alias, verify tokenizer_available and zero fallback requests; derive matching immutable CostSpec/model identity. Do not compare policies under an unverified heuristic fallback.
remaining_P0: portable raw-to-table and final claims audit
